WORK_PROJECT_AMBER_DESCRIPTION: Learning makes me happy~ This single-page application exists so I can study web architecture. I reinvent nearly every wheel, but doing so helps me understand how each component works and why it is designed that way.
WORK_PROJECT_CODETRACE_AI_DESCRIPTION: To free up my hands, I tried using Claude Code to automate the entire development pipeline, from a single requirements document all the way to delivery. AI really is badass!
WORK_PROJECT_ROUTING_DESCRIPTION: A graph-based routing study combining constraints, dynamic models, and shortest-path strategies. It is still in progress; I will share it whenever I finally figure it out~ At this point, it may come down to luck~
WORK_PROJECT_WEBPAGE_CORE_DESCRIPTION: A set of framework-free foundation services that connects page data, rendering, and interaction responsibilities. (It is also here because I needed a fourth item for the Stitch layout.)
TRAVEL_TITLE: I come to know a place only by moving through it.
TRAVEL_STATEMENT: Routes, light, and chance encounters become the traces that time leaves behind.
CHRONICLE_STATEMENT: Visual Journal 2025: Life, code, the poetry, and the paperwork.
NARRATIVE_FOCUS_DESCRIPTION: Continuing to refine this personal web system, pursue the questions behind it, bring it closer to completion, and record the stories it preserves.
NARRATIVE_FOCUS_ALT: SeeChen standing beside a bridge at night
NARRATIVE_BUILD_DESCRIPTION: Learning by building a framework-free interface system around explicit lifecycle, data, rendering, and interaction boundaries.
NARRATIVE_BUILD_ALT: A software development workspace with code and data on screen
NARRATIVE_LOCATION_DESCRIPTION: The weather in Kuala Lumpur is always changing its mind, though most days seem to settle into a soft shade of gray~
NARRATIVE_LOCATION_ALT: A view across Kuala Lumpur after rain
NARRATIVE_JOURNEY_DESCRIPTION: Recording routes, light, and the quieter details that remain in memory long after I leave a place.
